banner.title: A few projects
banner.subtitle: At 42 there are no classes and no teachers: you learn by building projects and reviewing other students' code. I've written everything from C to React there, and that's where I got interested in data.

highlights.rag: A complete RAG pipeline in TypeScript: document ingestion, chunking, TF-IDF index and cosine-similarity search.
highlights.transcendance: A multiplayer web app built as a team: real-time quiz, user accounts, microservice architecture.
highlights.irc: An IRC server in C++ handling many clients at once over sockets.
highlights.minishell: A Unix shell written in C, with pipes, redirections and signal handling.
highlights.inception: A Docker Compose infrastructure: Nginx, WordPress and MariaDB, each in its own container.
highlights.data: Data analysis with NumPy and pandas, then a linear regression written without any ML library.
